_doc: Values of run VCV (logs/VCV.events.txt, logs/VCV.RUN_INFO, logs/VCV.time.txt, logs/VCV.image.elf): simulation (simulate.sh) of a git archive of tag r11-rc9 (commit 8e116db, repo_state=archive) of car_v (CAR-V, 23 tasks, 4x4 mesh) with the release by tick (RELEASE_MASK=65535, release=tick), the UCX-OS kernel without nested interrupts (isr=no_nesting), the crt0.s with the return test of _isr and the read back of _interrupt_set(0) (crt0=guard_readback) and the time-triggered injection of the packets between PEs (injection=tt; table app/car_v_tt.h with t(v) = max(CSV, static t(v) of the image), costs=max_csv_static costs_file=car_v.json) at F_CLK = 441.088 MHz, 11.5 ms of platform time, Questa 2025.3, riscv64-elf-gcc 12.2.0, on the GAPH server, 2026-10-15 (run_r11g.sh: make -C experiments/car-v-rtl sim F_CLK=441088000 SIM_NS=11500000 BUILD=build/vcv). Analysis: make -C experiments/car-v-rtl analyze check-run phase-check LOG=logs/VCV.events.txt REF=reference_VCV.json OUTDIR=build/results_VCV (python -m rttools.paper.rtlapp, release rule tick from the RUN_INFO; link schedule of arch/hermes-4x4.gml). Model of the run (the defaults of rttools): the network interface of each PE as a resource of the link schedule, o_i = L0 + 20 (m + 1) + w_NI (w_NI = 15169), and t(v) = max(CSV, static t(v)) of the costs file of RUN_INFO (experiments/wcet/costs/tt), the deadline of each packet at the release tick of its reader and the finish of each job with the handlers of the packet events of its PE (deadline=tick in RUN_INFO); tt: each packet against s_{i,j}, o_i and its deadline, each job end against F(v), each enqueue against s_{i,j}, each arrival against the start of its reader (rttools/paper/ttcheck.py).

tt.model: o_i = L0 + w_h (m + 1) + w_NI; tau = tick of the phase of the sending job
